text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: ...It's finally here, huh. The Arima Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Bourbon-san and McQueen-san are
both running in it, right?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
"Just a little.
I might be a tiny bit scared."

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
"What if I lose? What if I let everyone down?
...What if I make everyone unhappy?"

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
When I think about that,
a chill spreads from my fingertips.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: "So, at times like this... you place your hand on your chest like this—"

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: I need to remember everyone's smiles.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Then Rice's heart feels all warm, and she knows she'll be okay.
choice_data_list: Go and give it your all right to the end.
